arabic text: YUN UTTHE MATAME SARWAR MEIN AZADAAR KE HAATH
english translation text: THE AZADAARS OF IMAM HUSAIN RAISE THEIR HANDS IN MAATAM

arabic text: YUN UTHE MATAME SARWAR MEIN AZADAAR KE HAATH\nPEHLE TAKBEER UTTHE JAISE KE DEEN DAAR KE HAATH
english translation text: THE AZADAARS OF IMAM HUSAIN RAISE THEIR HANDS IN MAATAM,\nJUST AS THE WORSHIPPERS RAISE THEIR HANDS IN THE TAKBIRATUL IHRAM (OF SALAT)

arabic text: JISNE LARTE HUWE ABBAS KO RANME DEKHA\nUSKO YAAD AAYE YADULLAH KI TALWAAR KE HAATH
english translation text: REMEMBERED THE SWORD IN YADULLAH’S HANDS (IMAM ALI A.S.)\nWHOEVER SAW ABBAS FIGHTING IN THE BATTLEFIELD,

arabic text: ROKE BACHO NE KAHAA AB NA MILEGA PAANI\nKAT GAYE NEHR PE ABBAS ALAMDAR KE HAATH
english translation text: THE CHILDREN CRIED BITTERLY AND SAID, NOW WE WILL NOT GET ANY WATER,\nTHE HANDS OF ABBAS ALAMDAR HAVE BEEN SEVERED AT THE RIVER FURAT

arabic text: MERE ASGHER HAI KAHAAN MAA NE TADAPKER POOCHA\nAAYE KHALI JO NAZAR SAYYADE ABRAAR KE HAATH
english translation text: WHERE IS MY ASGHAR, THE MOTHER TREMBLED AND ASKED,\nWHEN SHE SAW THE IMAM’S HANDS EMPTY

arabic text: GHIRNE PAR UNTON SE HAATHO KA SAHAARA KYALE\nBHANDE GHARDAN SE LAEEONE THE BEEMAR KE HAATH
english translation text: HOW WOULD IMAM SAJJAD (A.S.) USE HIS HANDS WHEN HE FELL FROM THE CAMEL,\nTHE CURSED PEOPLE HAD TIED HIS HANDS BEHIND HIS NECK

arabic text: FATEMA AAGYENGI MEHSHAR ME SHIFAAT KELIYE\nLEKE AAGHOSH ME ABBAS ALAMDAR KE HAATH
english translation text: SAYYIDA FATIMA (S.A.) WILL COME TO INTERCEDE ON THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT,\nSHE WILL BE CARRYING THE HANDS OF ABBAS IN HER CLOAK
